extension.summary: Stream Tata Play Binge (OTT + Live) channels on Kodi
extension.description: Watch your Tata Play Binge subscribed channels (incl. Zee TV networks) and OTT entitlements directly in Kodi. Log in with your registered mobile number (RMN) + subscriber ID via OTP. If an error occurs, use "Upload kodi.log for debugging" so it can be fixed.
extension.news: [- 1.0.10 -] [fixed] Login: session token now extracted correctly (login response uses "userAuthenticateToken", extraction is case-insensitive) - login succeeded server-side but the session was never saved; also fixed Settings.set_string / Script.open_settings crashes in codequick [- 1.0.9 -] [fixed] Login: subscriber/details now sends the missing platform: BINGE_ANYWHERE header (was code 400 "Missing request head") so account baId is returned - fixes "Null or empty ba id" on the update user login step [- 1.0.8 -] [fixed] Login: existing accounts (firstTimeLogin=false) now use "update existing user" instead of "create new user" - create returned HTTP 500 for already-registered non-DTH accounts [added] subscriber/details call result now logged for diagnosis [- 1.0.7 -] [fixed] Login rewritten for NON-DTH (Binge-only) accounts: RMN + OTP now uses the Binge web platform (www.tataplaybinge.com / tb.tapi.videoready.tv) - no subscriber ID needed, matching the Binge app [- 1.0.6 -] [fixed] Login/OTP APIs updated to the current Tata Play web platform (tm.tapi.videoready.tv) - OTP was returning 404 [- 1.0.5 -] [fixed] CRITICAL: "Script.run() AttributeError" - the addon entry now calls codequick's run correctly [- 1.0.4 -] [fixed] CRITICAL: "No module named 'constants'" crash on every menu/action - the addon could not run at all before this. Utilities now import with the correct package paths [- 1.0.3 -] [fixed] Any addon crash now shows the full error on screen (and is saved to the addon profile folder as binge_error.txt) - no more guessing from "check the log" [fixed] "Upload kodi.log" / "Send OTP" / "Login" now display the exact exception text on screen if they fail, so the problem can be read instantly [- 1.0.2 -] [added] "Upload kodi.log for debugging": Settings > Diagnostics, and an entry in the add-on menu - posts kodi.log to paste.rs and shows the link to share [added] Detailed BINGE log lines for login, channel list, channel detail, token service, OTT API and playback so errors read clearly in kodi.log [fixed] Login no longer crashes silently - errors are logged and surfaced [- 1.0.1 -] [fixed] Settings now use the classic Kodi schema so the Account/Login options are visible on all versions/tables [added] In-add-on login flow: open the add-on and choose "Login with RMN + OTP" (no need to open settings) [- 1.0.0 -] [added] Tata Play Binge addon [added] OTP login via registered mobile number + subscriber ID [added] Live channels from Binge lineup (entitlement filtered) [added] Dedicated Zee TV section (all Zee network channels via Binge) [added] DASH/Widevine playback with per-channel ls_session token [added] M3U playlist generation for PVR IPTV Simple
extension.disclaimer: This addon is not officially commissioned/supported by Tata Play. It relies on reverse-engineered public APIs of the Tata Play Binge OTT service. You need an active Tata Play Binge subscription.
